notes.title: JULY DEV UPDATE
notes.content:
Due to a known bug, Edge of Dawn no longer appears as Early Access.  I know many of you would like to get your hands on Edge of Dawn as soon as possible, so I’ve decided to adjust to a full release in order to shorten the delay. The release date is now [u]July 15, @1:00pm CDT[/u]. 

[h1]July 10th, UPDATE[/h1]

[list]
[*] CPU & GPU Optimization
[*] New Mini-Map
[*] Improved Horde AI
[*] 3 New Enemies
[*] New Areas
[*] Foliage Optimization
[*] LOD Overhaul
[*] Patched Hunger & Frost Status
[*] New Respawn System
[*] New Music
[*] New AI Behaviors
[*] 3 New Traps
[*] More Weapons
[/list]
